title: Deterministic Integer 3SUM in O(n^1.999017) Time via a Sharper Binomial-Tail Analysis
summary: We refine the analysis of the deterministic integer 3SUM algorithm of Alman and Vassilevska Williams (arXiv:2610.06783v1). Within their framework of thin matrix products and reductions through Exact Triangle, we obtain a worst-case running time of O(n^1.999017) for polynomially bounded integer inputs on a word RAM with O(log n)-bit words. The main refinement retains the binomial tail in the preprocessing cost instead of replacing it immediately by a uniform geometric bound.
